data.fund_type: Large Cap Fund - An open ended equity scheme predominantly investing in large cap stocks.
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective is to seek to generate long term capital appreciation from a portfolio that is substantiallyconstituted of equity and equity related securities of large cap companies. From time to time, the fund manager will also seekparticipation in other equity and equity related securities to achieve optimal portfolio construction. There is no assurance thatthe investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: 1. (a) Equity & equity related instruments of large cap companies - 80% - 100% (b) Investment in other equity and equity relatedinstruments - 0% - 20% 2. Debt and Money Market Securities - 0% - 20% 3. Units of InvITs - 0% - 10%
data.exit_load: 1% - Holding period from the date of allotment < 12 months, Nil - Holding period from the date of allotment >= 12 months (as a% of Applicable NAV)
